b: No one in my life cares about my weight loss, or else if they do care, they’re somewhat hostile to it. But my story is that I lost 80lbs after I had my 4th kid in 2023. Then, since I already have four and I’m almost 40, we decided, “what’s one more?!” and had number 5 in 2025. He’s a delight and I’m so grateful for him. But I gained 60 of those 80lbs back during the pregnancy…well, I’m happy to say I did it AGAIN. 2 weeks shy of my 40th birthday, I sit here 5’9, 136lbs, BMI of 20 (my highest weight ever was 220 lbs, BMI 30). I’m wearing a pair of SIZE 0 jeans (which seems insane because I wouldn’t say I am underweight or anything). I feel amazing but mostly just proud of myself for having the discipline to do it not just once, but twice. And now that I’m here, with all my beautiful babies, I feel confident to maintain this weight for the foreseeable future. I’m really happy!
(My husband is also proud of me, but there’s only so many times he can say it, you know? And I don’t discuss weight loss with my children in this way)
